title: Noncommutative Maximal Averages over Submanifolds and Variable Hypersurfaces
summary: We establish maximal inequalities for geometric averages of operator-valued functions in noncommutative \(L^p\)-spaces associated with semifinite von Neumann algebras. For averages over a fixed smooth submanifold of finite type at the parameter origin, we prove local maximal bounds for every \(1 n/(n-1)\). The finite-type and polynomial estimates rely on a weak type \((1,1)\) inequality for a regularized auxiliary family adapted to non-isotropic dilations.
